name: devicekit-serp
description: Search the web from your fleet's real Chrome — not a key-based SERP API. Runs google/bing/duckduckgo queries through devicekit-browser's device pool, so every search carries a real-device fingerprint and residential IP, rotates across the fleet, and costs nothing per query. Owns no device code: it is a thin consumer of the devicekit-browser extension (plan 17's dependency demo).
author: Juan Denis
